name: Seafoam Studio
inspiration: A Sea Foam Green Stratocaster in a Swiss design studio: bone-white walls, graphite ink, one perfect green. Strict grid, enormous type, transitions that are precise rather than loud.

display.stack: 'Archivo Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif
display.note: One family, many weights — Swiss discipline. Display at 800 weight, tight tracking, huge sizes

body.stack: 'Archivo Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif
body.note: Same family at 400; hierarchy from size and weight only

utility.stack: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, Menlo, monospace

motion.note: Sections live as cards on a strict grid. Selecting one FLIPs it (GSAP Flip plugin) from its grid cell to fullscreen — position, size and radius morph continuously — while sibling cards recede with a fade-scale. Content staggers in on a vertical rhythm. Closing FLIPs it back to its cell.
